periods.label: 王马的影子

status.current: waiting for the coming Akatsuki operation and interested in Stella

relationships.stella-vermillion: Reason he is participating; he wants to meet or test her but shows no concern for her illness.
relationships.or-gaule: Converses with him after the puppet attack and disdains his clownish style.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother referenced by Or-Gaule as more straightforward.

periods.summary: Ouma appears only as a dark, cold figure speaking with Or-Gaule after the Okutama puppet incident. He says he is merely a guest and that he joined the farce to see Stella, but if she cannot compete because of illness then she is only that much. Or-Gaule contrasts his coldness with his simpler younger brother, identifying him by implication as Ikki's elder brother and foreshadowing a future confrontation.

key_events.summary: Speaks with Or-Gaule and reveals his interest in Stella.

periods.label: 烈风剑帝压倒破军
periods.affiliation: Bukyoku Academy cover; Akatsuki Academy; Kurogane family by blood

status.current: confirmed Seven Stars participant under Akatsuki banner
status.public_profile: Japanese student A-rank who had vanished from public competition for about five years

personality.summary: Severe, strength-obsessed and emotionally detached; rejects his family as something already discarded.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother whom he dismisses and refuses to treat as family.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister, likewise discarded in his view.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Primary target as a fellow A-rank student; overpowers her Salamander with Kusanagi.
relationships.toka-todo: Allows her a free chance to wound him; defeats her after Takemikazuchi only grazes him.

periods.summary: Ouma's return to public competition is discussed throughout the camp as a major threat: he is Ikki's older brother, an A-rank student, and someone who abandoned public tournaments because he found no worthy opponents. He appears with Akatsuki during the Hagun attack, rejects Ikki's attempt to speak as family, and focuses on Stella. His wind sword Kusanagi overpowers Stella's Calusaritio Salamander and later defeats Toka after her Raikiri and unfinished Takemikazuchi fail to meaningfully injure his body. He also calmly decides not to pursue Ikki and Shizuku because Wallenstein and Edelweiss wait at Akatsuki's base.

key_events.summary: Journalists and Ikki describe his return and strength obsession.
Overpowers Stella's strongest fire sword and forces Toka's tactical retreat.
Defeats Toka after she barely wounds him.

periods.time: Night before Ikki's first Seven Stars match
periods.label: 烈风剑帝的赛外袭击
titles: 日本学生唯一A级伐刀者

status.current: withdraws after Moroboshi blocks his attempt to finish Ikki

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother whom he orders to withdraw, calling his strength trickery and blaming him for hindering Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Considers her a worthy A-rank talent and believes Ikki's influence weakened her.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former Little League rival; Moroboshi counters Kusanagi with Tiger Bite and forces Ouma to stop.

periods.summary: Ouma stalks Ikki after the dinner at Ittousei and demands that he withdraw from Seven Stars, claiming Ikki's low-rank tactics misled Stella and blocked her growth. When Ikki refuses, Ouma attacks with Dragon Claw, vacuum blades, the oxygen-removing Muukuu Barrier, and Kusanagi. The fight exposes Ikki's mysterious freezing symptom linked to the Edelweiss duel. Moroboshi arrives with Ikki's student handbook, uses Tiger Bite to destroy Kusanagi and Muukuu Barrier, and Ouma leaves while predicting Ikki will lose to Moroboshi.

key_events.summary: Attempts to force Ikki's withdrawal and nearly kills him before Moroboshi intervenes.

periods.time: Seven Stars first-round B-block through second-round A-block
periods.label: 烈风剑帝等待红莲觉醒
periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy guest; Kurogane family; Tsukikage/Itsuki side by convenience

status.current: wins A-block second-round match against Renji Kaga and continues pursuing a decisive battle with Stella

personality.summary: Austere, strength-obsessed and dismissive of politics; he cooperates with schemes only when they serve his hunt for an absolute trial.
fears: an unresolved terror symbolized by his trembling right hand

relationships.stella-vermillion: Target whose world-class magical capacity he wants awakened so he can face overwhelming power and overcome his fear.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; Ouma allows him to stay overnight and reveals enough motives to regain some of Ikki's respect.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father whose request led Ouma to assist Tsukikage's anti-League plan as a convenient side arrangement.
relationships.bakuga-tsukikage: Political ally of convenience; Ouma is uninterested in Tsukikage's full plan.
relationships.renji-kaga: A-block second-round opponent defeated before the schedule compression is discussed.

periods.summary: Ouma watches Stella's Brute Dragon Roar from the VIP area and is the first to help contain it with a wind wall because he does not want her to restrain herself again. That reaction confirms for Stella and others that her full power can be contained, while Ouma is excited by her awakened spirit. Later Ikki takes refuge in Ouma's room, and Ouma explains that he is not truly Rebellion but a guest student aligned with Tsukikage because Itsuki asked him to help the anti-League plan. His real reason remains Stella: he believes magic power is the force by which knights impose their destiny, and only Stella's world-best capacity can become an absolute, inescapable threat he needs to overcome. The next day he defeats Renji Kaga in A-block second round, remaining on course in the tournament.

key_events.summary: Uses wind to help direct Stella's blast away from spectators.
Explains his alignment with Tsukikage and obsession with Stella's absolute potential.
Wins A-block second-round match against Steel Grizzly Renji Kaga.

periods.label: 烈风剑帝残酷晋级准决赛

status.current: defeats Renji Kaga and advances to the semifinal against Stella
status.condition: unharmed and still not fully revealed

personality.summary: Cold, battle-obsessed and merciless, but serious toward opponents who face him directly.

abilities_owned: extreme durability or defense not fully explained

relationships.renji-kaga: Former childhood rival; Ouma cuts off his limbs and crushes his heart because Renji challenges him directly.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Upcoming semifinal opponent; he smiles when she vows to force out his full power.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother on the opposite side of the bracket.

periods.summary: Ouma enters the A-block third-round match against Renji Kaga with a swordlike pressure that silences the arena. Renji unveils a six-armed steel-body technique created to beat him, but Ouma simply walks into the attack, withstands the blows, and cuts off Renji's added arms, remaining arms and legs. Before the referee can stop him, Ouma pierces Renji's chest and crushes his heart, forcing emergency intervention by Kurono. Stella alone applauds him, judging that he treated Renji's strength seriously, and declares she will force him to reveal his true power in the semifinal. Ouma answers with a savage smile that he was thinking the same thing.

key_events.summary: Brutally defeats Renji and advances to face Stella.

periods.label: 以天龙甲冑逼迫自身进化的烈风剑帝

status.current: defeated by Stella in the semifinal but remains spiritually unbroken
status.condition: suffers catastrophic burns, fractures, and unconsciousness while still standing at the end

personality.summary: Severe toward himself and others, single-mindedly pursuing the world's summit for the simple desire to be first.

abilities_owned: Heavenly Dragon Armor / 天龙甲冑
Dan Getsu Tenryu Claw / 断月天龙爪

relationships.stella-vermillion: Semifinal opponent; deliberately draws out her full strength and is defeated by her awakened dragon power.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother who respects Ouma's severe training and identifies him as a formative model despite their conflict.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Akatsuki project's A-rank representative under Tsukikage's political gamble.
relationships.edelweiss: Saved him from Tyrant after Ouma's crushing defeat during his wandering training.
relationships.tyrant: The Rebellion leader whose overwhelming power broke Ouma's self-satisfaction and drove his forced evolution.

periods.summary: Ouma enters the semifinal against Stella as the other A-rank favorite. He blocks Stella's fire with wind, reveals that his body has become steel-like because he spent years wearing his own Heavenly Dragon Armor as crushing pressure, and overwhelms her with speed, durability, Vacuum Blades, Fire Thunder, and Amaterasu. He explains that after winning the U-12 world tournament he sought real battles, was crushed by Rebellion's Tyrant, and decided ordinary training could never reach the summit, so he forced his body to evolve. Stella's awakened Dragon Spirit reverses the match, burning him internally and breaking his limbs. Even after collapsing, he rises by holding his bones with air pressure and challenges her with Dan Getsu Tenryu Claw. Stella's Katharterio Salamandra cuts through his storm and the sea beyond, ending the match, but he remains standing without yielding in spirit until medical staff arrive.

key_events.summary: Forces Stella to awaken and then loses to her dragon power.

periods.time: Afternoon before the final and next day's ceremony
periods.label: 检验弟弟的烈风剑帝
titles: 七星剑武祭季军（天音失格后递补）

status.current: tests Ikki before leaving Osaka; receives third place by default but is absent from ceremony
status.condition: defeated by Stella in semifinal but still overwhelming in training

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; tests whether Ikki's weak sword can face a dragon and finally offers all his techniques for Ikki to exploit.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Semifinal opponent who defeated him and whose strength he uses as the benchmark for Ikki.

periods.summary: Ouma appears at Ikki's training session despite Ikki having expected no reply. He declares that if Ikki's half-hearted power cannot face the dragon, he will break Ikki's dull sword before the final. His Amatsukaze, Tenryuu Gusoku, vacuum blades and Amaterasu overwhelm Ikki, but Ikki tricks him out of the ring and insists that his sword exists to win, not to look strong. Ouma accepts that this may be a form of strength and offers his full repertoire so Ikki can try to overturn fate. He later leaves Osaka before the ceremony despite being awarded third place by default after Amane's disqualification.

key_events.summary: Arrives as the most severe pre-finale test and helps Ikki stop fearing Stella.
Is named third place by default but does not attend.

periods.time: Immediately after crossing Eurasia to the former Rebellion headquarters
periods.label: 跨越昔日恐惧的烈风剑帝

status.current: escorts Tsukikage, Kazamatsuri, Rinna, Sara and Charlotte back toward Japan after Nango covers the retreat
status.condition: severely injured from Tatra base battle but mobile through pressure and willpower

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Rescues her at Charlotte's request after she is kidnapped by US forces.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Responds to her emergency call and follows her directions to the Tatra base.
relationships.abraham-carter: Discovers Abraham, not the Tyrant, was the enemy who once crushed him; defeats one clone with his completed wind sword before being suppressed by numbers.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Accepts Nango's order to retreat with the rescued captives while Nango holds the rear.
relationships.stella-vermillion: His previous duel with Stella erased the fear that once froze him before the Tyrant's power.

periods.summary: Ouma reaches the ruined Rebellion base seeking revenge on the Tyrant, but finds Charlotte hidden by Sara's magic and learns Rinna's group has been taken by the US military. He attacks the Tatra base alone, shelters Charlotte with wind camouflage, annihilates soldiers and tanks, and duels Abraham Carter. Learning that Abraham was the unseen enemy who once traumatized him, Ouma rejoices at the chance to surpass his old fear. After seeing Rinna and Sara's torture he abandons his self-imposed purity, devours the surrounding wind, completes Danzuki Tenryuusou: Shinuchi and cuts down one Abraham with Ippatsu no Kaze. He is then overwhelmed by dozens of clones until Nango arrives, after which he rescues the captives and carries them toward Japan.

key_events.summary: Finds Charlotte at the ruined base and agrees to rescue Rinna.
Defeats one Abraham Carter with a perfected wind sword but is then pinned by clone numbers.
Leaves the battlefield with the hostages under Nango's protection.
Carries the group toward Japan as Tsukikage collapses from prophetic nightmares.

periods.label: 烈风剑帝作为兄长与盾

status.condition: critically burned while shielding others, but survives

personality.summary: Ouma remains blunt, severe and strength-focused, yet his actions show responsibility toward his siblings and comrades. He pushes Ikki forward by refusing to let him confuse self-destruction with victory.
flaws: tends to frame care as challenge or criticism

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Younger brother; initially restrains him on Itsuki's order, later entrusts Stella's rescue to him and rebukes his despair.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Younger sister; fights alongside her and benefits from her final plan.
relationships.toka-todo: Fights with her against Abraham series, combining wind and lightning as godlike forces.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Protects him during the Abraham battle and later during the possessed Stella aftermath.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rescue target and later possessed threat; he shields the team from her Bahamut Soul.

periods.summary: Fresh from rescuing Prime Minister Tsukikage, Ouma joins Itsuki at Hagun and is ordered onto the Stella rescue team. He transports slower members with wind, blocks mercenary fire with Tenryu Kacchu, destroys fortifications and Large EDY units, and stays behind with Touka and Alice to fight Abraham clones while Ikki and Shizuku continue downward. Against the Abrahams he unleashes a strengthened Kusanagi/Shinuchi by gathering external wind. When possessed Stella uses Bahamut Soul, Ouma spends his wind armor protecting Alice and Touka rather than himself, leaving him gravely burned. Even then he stands and rebukes Ikki for giving up on victory, helping restore Ikki's resolve to save rather than kill Stella.

key_events.summary: Clears mercenaries and EDY units with wind techniques and brute force.
Stays on the fourth floor to fight Abraham clones so Ikki and Shizuku can advance.
Uses his wind armor to protect comrades from Stella's possessed Bahamut Soul.
Rebukes Ikki's self-destructive despair and insists no one has died yet.
